Vanessa — thanks for the ping. Quick legal notes after an initial pass:

1) Transfers: our standard approach is to execute our DPA with the EU Commission SCCs (2021 set) appended; we can also rely on other adequacy mechanisms where applicable, but SCCs are the predictable default. If Silverline requires additional safeguards we can add a technical addendum (e.g., encrypting specific fields at rest).

2) PHI: we do not route PHI to any external processor by default; however, some customers do send sensitive clinical notes. We need Silverline to confirm the data types they expect to ingest. If PHI is anticipated, we'll require the customer to select a Dedicated/Private deployment or accept our enhanced safeguards (we should call this out early).

3) Subprocessors: we can share a current subprocessor inventory pre-signature if they sign an NDA, otherwise we'll share a sanitized list noting categories (e.g., cloud infra, observability). We prefer to share the full list once the DPA is at least in execution-stage.

4) Signing platform: DocuSign is preferred by legal because of robust audit logs; Adobe Sign is acceptable but we'll need to ensure the envelope/audit trail meets our retention requirements. Practically, I don't expect a blocker — propose we offer DocuSign by default and accommodate Adobe Sign if Silverline insists.

I've attached a first-pass redline PDF with commentary (DPA_Redlines_20260828.pdf). Main asks we expect from enterprise customers: limits on subprocessors' sub-subprocessing, data export controls, and explicit retention override language.

Proposed next steps:
- Vanessa / Ben: provide confirmation whether sales will accept a DocuSign-first workflow.
- Vanessa: ask Silverline to confirm whether PHI will be included in the pilot and whether they will sign an NDA to receive the full subprocessor inventory.
- Marissa: I'll prepare a short MAP (mutual action plan) we can share with their procurement including expected milestones and a DocuSign link if they agree.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

- We are happy to sign an NDA to receive the full subprocessor roster; procurement will route a quick mutual NDA today.
- Signing: Adobe Sign is our procurement team's standard due to existing workflows, but we can accept DocuSign if it speeds execution. Either is fine.

Could you send the MAP and the DocuSign/AdobeSign envelope once you have the redline? Procurement is targeting EOW 2026-09-03. If we can get the MAP + DPA by Tuesday (2026-08-31) we should be able to hit that date.
